articles.headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo scores 20, Heat roll past Rockets 128-110 for 5th straight win
articles.description: — Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 20 points and grabbed 13 rebounds, Andrew Wiggins and Klay Thompson each scored 17 and the Miami Heat never trailed on the way to beating the Houston Rockets 128-110 on Monday night for their fifth straight victory.

articles.headline: Bane scores 24, Magic rally in 4th quarter to beat Celtics 115-105, extend win streak to 4 games
articles.description: — Desmond Bane had 24 points and eight rebounds to help the Orlando Magic rally in the fourth quarter and earn their fourth consecutive victory, 115-105 over the Boston Celtics on Monday night.
